name: domain-ai-assistant
description: The npm workspace of every JS/TS app and library, and the repo-wide JS/TS quality gate (ADR-0021). The Mermaid CLI renders the diagrams of the level-N.md releases (plan 0002, T15).

scripts.boundaries: node tools/quality/js-ts/gen_depcruise.ts --check && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.json apps libs tools && node tools/quality/js-ts/boundaries.ts
